cues.zh: 如果我們儲存這個檔案，回到頁面並重新載入，你應該會看到這個 section 現在

cues.en: has a red background and that already is your first CSS code, this is how you can change the style
cues.zh: 有紅色背景。這已經是你的第一段 CSS 程式碼，這就是你如何改變

cues.en: of an element, in this case, of the section.
cues.zh: 一個元素的樣式，這裡是 section。

cues.en: Now this was achieved by creating a so-called inline style, inline because we use the style attribute
cues.zh: 這是透過建立所謂的行內樣式達成的。行內，是因為我們把 style 屬性

cues.en: directly on the element where you want to add it and you would write all styles, if you have multiple
cues.zh: 直接加在你想套用的元素上。如果你有多個樣式，全部樣式

cues.en: ones, you can separate them with semi-colons in the same line.
cues.zh: 可以在同一行用分號分開。

cues.en: Now this approach is actually not recommended because if you create a bigger page with many styles, it
cues.zh: 這個做法其實不建議。因為如果你做一個有很多樣式的較大頁面，

cues.en: quickly becomes very hard to understand and read your code because your style is always applied to the
cues.zh: 程式碼會很快變得很難理解、很難讀，因為樣式總是套在

cues.en: element you want to change.
cues.zh: 你想改變的元素上。

cues.en: If you ever want to change a style, you have to find that element in your document flow and this is
cues.zh: 如果以後想改某個樣式，你得在文件流程裡找到那個元素，這

cues.en: really hard to debug.
cues.zh: 真的很難除錯。

cues.en: Additionally if you add multiple rules, let's say you have like 10 different properties you want to change,
cues.zh: 此外，如果你加多條規則，假設有大約 10 個不同屬性想改，

cues.en: you get a very long list of properties you assign here and that also is hard to read.
cues.zh: 你會在這裡得到一長串要指定的屬性，那也很難讀。

cues.en: So there is a better way of writing CSS and that way actually uses so-called selectors.
cues.zh: 所以有更好的 CSS 寫法，那種寫法其實使用所謂的選擇器。

cues.en: Let's dive into that approach
cues.zh: 下一支影片我們會深入那個做法，

cues.en: and then the two remaining alternatives of including CSS code in the next video.
cues.zh: 以及另外兩種引入 CSS 程式碼的方式。
